extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia users or new contributors attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who attempt to create a new Wikipedia page (here: 'Eddie Murphy SNL'), covering account requirements, searches for existing pages, redirects, and troubleshooting deleted or recently-created pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Eddie Murphy SNL" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation / database delay troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page has been deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
